plain_text:
HOLYOKE HOUSING AUTHORITY REGULAR BOARD MEETING
Thursday, August 6, 2026, at 12:00 PM
475 Maple Street, Holyoke, MA
AGENDA:
To approve minutes of the June 18, 2026 meeting
A) RESOLUTIONS:
1. Second Quarter Write Offs
To approve writing off $11,570 in State Bad Tenant Debt and $16,385.26 in Federal Bad
Tenant Debt for a total write off of $27,955.21.
2. Valley Bike Installation
To approve execution of a license agreement with the city for the installation of a Valley Bike e
bike terminal at Zielinski Apartments.
3. Store Front Improvements Change Order No.1 Approval and Contract Closeout
To approve Change Order No. 1 in the amount of $12,998.80 for additional concrete work.
To approve both the substantial and final closeout of the project.
4. Toepfert Security Improvement Contract Award
To award the Toepfert Apartments Security Improvements Contract to Goodless Electric in the
amount of $239,800 for the base bid contingent upon HUD approval.
B. CURRENT ISSUES REPORTS (open for discussion)
Maintenance/Admissions
Modernization Report
Development Report
Finance Department Report
Resident Services Report
Leased Housing
MIS Department
Senior Property Manager Report
Human Resources Report
C. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
D. NEW BUSINESS
E. EXECUTIVE SESSION
F. ADJOURN
The listing of matters is those anticipated by the Chair, which may be discussed at the meeting.
Not all items listed may in fact be discussed, and other items not listed may also be brought up
for discussion to the extent permitted by law.
